surprises.title: Ground wire is missing
surprises.description: You open the box and find two cloth-wrapped wires and zero ground. Vintage!

options.text: Rewire the whole house
Have an electrician add a GFCI
Connect the ground to the neutral

surprises.title: Wire insulation crumbles
surprises.description: You bend the old wire and the insulation flakes off like a croissant.

options.text: Rewire the whole floor
Wrap the bare spots in electrical tape
Cut back to good wire or replace the run

surprises.title: Box is too small
surprises.description: Old wires plus new wires do not fit in this tiny box. Not even close.

options.text: Swap in a larger box
Rewire the whole room
Cram everything in and push hard

surprises.title: Box can't hold the weight
surprises.description: The new fixture weighs 25 pounds. The box is held up by one rusty nail.

options.text: Install a rated box with a brace
Hang it with drywall anchors
Add a beam across the ceiling

surprises.title: Breaker isn't labeled
surprises.description: You flip six breakers. The light is still on. The fridge is not.

options.text: Shut off the main for the whole job
Work on it live with rubber gloves
Find it with a circuit tester and label it

surprises.title: Wire colors are wrong
surprises.description: The white wire is hot. Someone before you had a creative streak.

options.text: Test it and mark it with tape
Hire an electrician to redo every switch
Guess and flip the switch

surprises.title: Ceiling ring shows
surprises.description: The new canopy is smaller than the old one. There's a ring of ugly ceiling around it.

options.text: Patch and repaint the ring
Replace the whole ceiling
Add a ceiling medallion

surprises.title: Ceiling white clashes
surprises.description: Your patch is bright white. The ceiling is twenty years of a different white.

options.text: Repaint the whole ceiling
Dab on more touch-up paint
Repaint the whole house

surprises.title: Dimmer starts buzzing
surprises.description: The new LED fixture flickers, and the old dimmer hums like a mosquito.

options.text: Leave it; it'll stop eventually
Replace every switch in the house
Swap in an LED-compatible dimmer

surprises.title: Knob and tube appears
surprises.description: Behind the box: porcelain knobs and wires from your great-grandparents' era.

options.text: Rewire the whole house now
Pack insulation around it and close up
Have an electrician replace that run

surprises.title: Popcorn texture falls
surprises.description: Cutting the box hole showers you in popcorn texture from 1972.

options.text: Hire abatement for the whole house
Stop and send a sample to a lab
Keep going and sweep up later

surprises.title: Insulation rains down
surprises.description: Loose-fill attic insulation pours out of the hole and onto your head.

options.text: Wear a mask, bag it, and seal the hole
Vacuum it with the house vacuum
Re-insulate the whole attic

surprises.title: Other fixtures look dated
surprises.description: Your new fixture is stunning. Every other light now looks like a 1990s hotel.

options.text: Spray-paint the old fixtures gold
Replace them one at a time
Replace every fixture this weekend

surprises.title: Partner wants voice control
surprises.description: Your partner: "Could it work with voice commands?"

options.text: Install a whole-home automation hub
Tape a smart plug to the ceiling
Use smart bulbs in the new fixture

surprises.title: Ceiling fan tempts you
surprises.description: It's hot, and you're already up here. What if this were a ceiling fan?

options.text: Stick with the fixture
Install fans in every room
Hang the fan from the old light box

ask.question: How do I change a ceiling light?
ask.answer: Simple! 1. Take down the old light. 2. Match the colors. 3. Done!
ask.skipped: It skipped turning off the breaker.
